description: This source file defines a collection of classes, enums, and methods for managing system sound effects on macOS. It includes functionality for discovering sound files, providing sound options, and playing sounds using NSSound, along with handling security-scoped resources.

classes.name: SoundEffectPlayer
classes.description: A utility class to handle the playback of sounds, either by name or from a bookmark with security scope management.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an NSSound object by sound name, either directly or via URL from the catalog.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound instance from a security-scoped bookmark data.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound instance and retains a reference to it for subsequent control.
